name: Mohammad Al-Safadi
tagline: Laravel packages, desktop tools and small games, in Arabic and English.

featured.title: EchoSub
featured.text: Live translated captions for anything your PC plays, in about 100 languages, on your own GPU.

featured.title: AndroidDC
featured.text: One window over plain adb: mirroring, two-way tethering, files, apps and messages. No install.

featured.title: Game Forge
featured.text: Press one button and an AI designs, builds and self-tests a browser game. 14 game types.

featured.title: Wavebreak
featured.text: A cute 3D survivors-like with six maps, a boss on each, and online co-op for four players.

featured.title: Guess the Language
featured.text: A quiz game with 12 modes and a live global leaderboard, on Windows, the web and Discord.

featured.title: Prayer Times Break
featured.text: Prayer-time reminders in 11 languages. Can lock your open tabs for a set time.
